import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

hd = pd.read_excel('DuLieuBanHang.xlsx', sheet_name='DanhSachHoaDon')
dt = pd.read_excel('DanhSachHoaDonChiTiet.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1')

def parse_time(v):
    v = str(v).strip()
    if v.isdigit():
        base = datetime(1899,12,30)
        return base + timedelta(days=int(v))
    return pd.to_datetime(v, dayfirst=True)

hd['t'] = hd['Thời gian'].apply(parse_time)
hd['date'] = hd['t'].dt.date

# Cancelled / returned status labels
cancel_return = ['hủy đơn','Đã huỷ','trả hàng','Đã trả hàng']
hd['is_cancel_return'] = hd['Trạng thái'].isin(cancel_return)

# Join line items, sum Thành tiền per order
joined = dt.merge(hd[['Mã hóa đơn','date','is_cancel_return']], on='Mã hóa đơn', how='left')
joined['thanh_tien'] = pd.to_numeric(joined['Thành tiền'], errors='coerce')

# Revenue per day: only non-cancel/return orders
rev = joined[~joined['is_cancel_return']].groupby('date')['thanh_tien'].sum()

apr = rev[rev.index.month==4 & rev.index.year==2025]
top = apr.sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
print(top)
print("\nTotal days in April with revenue:", len(apr))
